content.problem:
What is the minor of ${x}_{12}$ in 
$X=[\begin{aligned}5 & 0 & 1 & -2 \\ 3 & 3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & 1 & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 4 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]?$
content.worked_solution:
To get the minor of ${x}_{12}$, we remove the $1$st row and $2$nd column:

$$
X=[\begin{aligned}∗ & 0 & ∗ & ∗ \\ 3 & ∗ & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & ∗ & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & ∗ & 1 & -2\end{aligned}]
$$

So, the minor is 

$$
{M}_{12}=|\begin{aligned}3 & 11 & 7 \\ \sqrt{2} & -8 & 8 \\ -6 & 1 & -2\end{aligned}|.
$$
